title: Find the Student that Will Replace the Chalk
goal: Find the first student who cannot complete their turn with the available chalk.
strategy: Full rounds consume a constant total, so reduce k modulo that total. Scan one partial round and require strictly less chalk than the current need to trigger replacement.
